```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mgcv)
library(lme4)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)

analysis_df <- read_csv("shark_analysis_with_sst.csv")
analysis_df$gamma <- analysis_df$g
```

```{r}
# Distribution of gamma (movement persistence)
summary(analysis_df$gamma)
mean(analysis_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(analysis_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)

# boundary checks (exact and near-boundary)
mean(analysis_df$gamma <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(analysis_df$gamma >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(analysis_df$gamma < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
mean(analysis_df$gamma > 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

# create a cleaned version for plotting/modeling (keep original unchanged)
analysis_df_clean <- analysis_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(gamma), gamma >= 0, gamma <= 1)

ggplot(analysis_df_clean, aes(x = gamma)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 40, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_density() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Gamma (movement persistence)", y = "Density")

```
```{r}
# Scatter: gamma vs SST
ggplot(analysis_df, aes(x = sst, y = gamma)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Sea Surface Temperature (°C)", y = "Gamma (movement persistence)")
```

```{r}
# Basic regression
fit_lm <- lm(gamma ~ sst, data = analysis_df)
summary(fit_lm)

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
plot(fit_lm$fitted.values, resid(fit_lm), xlab="Fitted", ylab="Residuals")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
qqnorm(resid(fit_lm)); qqline(resid(fit_lm))
par(mfrow = c(1,1))
```
```{r}
# Linear mixed model: random intercept for shark/track id
fit_lmm <- lmer(gamma ~ sst + (1 | id), data = analysis_df)
summary(fit_lmm)
```

```{r}
# Residual diagnostics for LMM
model_df <- model.frame(fit_lmm)
model_df$fitted_lmm <- fitted(fit_lmm)
model_df$resid_lmm  <- resid(fit_lmm)

ggplot(model_df, aes(x = fitted_lmm, y = resid_lmm)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Fitted values", y = "Residuals")

qqnorm(model_df$resid_lmm)
qqline(model_df$resid_lmm)
```


```{r}
# Logit transform gamma (trim to avoid 0/1)
model_df$gamma_trim  <- pmin(pmax(model_df$gamma, 0.001), 0.999)
model_df$gamma_logit <- qlogis(model_df$gamma_trim)

fit_lmm_logit <- lmer(gamma_logit ~ sst + (1 | id), data = model_df)
summary(fit_lmm_logit)

# Diagnostics on logit scale
model_df$fitted_logit <- fitted(fit_lmm_logit)
model_df$resid_logit  <- resid(fit_lmm_logit)

ggplot(model_df, aes(x = fitted_logit, y = resid_logit)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Fitted values (logit scale)", y = "Residuals")

qqnorm(model_df$resid_logit)
qqline(model_df$resid_logit)
```

```{r}
# Beta GAMM: nonlinear effect + random effect
model_df$gamma_beta <- pmin(pmax(model_df$gamma, 0.001), 0.999)

fit_gamm_beta <- gam(
  gamma_beta ~ s(sst) + s(id, bs = "re"),
  family = betar(link = "logit"),
  data = model_df,
  method = "REML"
)
summary(fit_gamm_beta)
```
